# iCreatePDF - 100% Client-Side, Privacy-Focused PDF Suite

> Free, unlimited, browser-based PDF utilities. All computations happen locally on the user's computer. Files never leave the browser sandbox. No registration, no ads, no trackers.
> Full technical specification: https://www.icreatepdf.online/llms-full.txt

iCreatePDF runs entirely in the browser using WebAssembly and JavaScript engines. It offers a secure alternative to server-side PDF editors where documents containing sensitive credentials or personal IDs must be uploaded to remote cloud infrastructure.

## PDF Editing & Security Tools

- [Homepage](https://www.icreatepdf.online/): Dashboard grid displaying all local document manipulation utilities.
- [Merge PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files locally into a single document in any page order.
- [Split PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/split-pdf): Split a PDF document into separate files or extract specific page ranges.
- [Organize PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/organize-pdf): Rearrange, delete, or rotate pages visually with inline canvas previews.
- [Compress PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file sizes by optimizing object streams client-side.
- [Watermark PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/watermark-pdf): Overlay custom text stamps, opacity control, and fonts on all PDF pages.
- [Page Numbers](https://www.icreatepdf.online/add-page-numbers): Stamp page numbers with flexible layout anchors and format tokens (e.g., "Page X of Y").
- [Protect PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/protect-pdf): Secure PDF files by applying strong local passwords and restrictions.
- [Unlock PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/unlock-pdf): Strip passwords and security restrictions from owned PDF documents.
- [Edit PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/edit-pdf): Add draggable text annotation overlays directly onto PDF layers in-browser.
- [Redact PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/redact-pdf): Burn permanent black concealment shapes onto pages to hide sensitive information.
- [Crop PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/crop-pdf): Adjust margins or trim scanner borders from pages locally.
- [Extract Pages](https://www.icreatepdf.online/extract-pages): Selectively pull and save specific ranges (e.g., 1, 3, 5-7) to a new PDF.
- [Delete Pages](https://www.icreatepdf.online/delete-pdf-pages): Remove specific pages from a PDF document in one click.
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/rotate-pdf): Rotate individual or all document pages clockwise by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- [Repair PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/repair-pdf): Recover damaged PDF documents by rebuilding corrupted cross-reference tables locally.
- [Bates Numbering](https://www.icreatepdf.online/bates-numbering): Apply sequential legal numbering stamps with prefixes, suffixes, and padding.
- [Header & Footer](https://www.icreatepdf.online/header-footer): Stamp custom header and footer metadata onto all pages.
- [Resize PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/resize-pdf): Normalize pages to standard sizes like A4, Letter, A3, Legal, or A5 in Portrait/Landscape.
- [Invert PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/invert-pdf): Pixel-invert colors on all pages for comfortable night reading (PDF Dark Mode).
- [Flatten PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/flatten-pdf): Merge form fields and interactive annotations into static read-only shapes.
- [Grayscale PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/grayscale-pdf): Convert colorful documents to pure black & white to optimize ink usage.
- [PDF Metadata](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-metadata): Inspect and modify hidden document traits (Title, Author, Subject, Keywords).
- [Compare PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/compare-pdf): Audit document revisions side-by-side with synchronized viewport scrolling.
- [Verify Signature](https://www.icreatepdf.online/verify-signature): Inspect digital certificates and verify cryptographic signature integrity locally.
- [Sign PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/sign-pdf): Draw or type electronic signatures and stamp them visually onto pages.
- [Read Aloud PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/read-aloud-pdf): Listen to PDF text using client-side Text-to-Speech (TTS) engine with voice and speed controls.
- [Certify PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/certify-pdf): Stamp any PDF with a cryptographic SHA-256 fingerprint and scannable QR code for verification.
- [PDF Accessibility Checker](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-accessibility-checker): Scan any PDF for screen-reader accessibility compatibility (tags, language declarations, alt text).
- [Prevent PDF Copy](https://www.icreatepdf.online/prevent-copy): Rasterizes text layers into crisp image shapes, disabling direct highlighting and text copy-pasting.
- [Bulk Certificate Generator](https://www.icreatepdf.online/bulk-certificates): Generate hundreds of personalized PDF certificates or letters in bulk from Excel/CSV templates.
- [Fillable PDF Form Builder](https://www.icreatepdf.online/fillable-pdf-builder): Design interactive, fillable PDF forms with text fields, dropdown lists, checkboxes, and radio choices locally.
- [N-Up PDF Layout](https://www.icreatepdf.online/n-up-pdf): Combine 2-up, 4-up, or 9-up PDF pages onto single sheets for handouts.
- [Booklet PDF Builder](https://www.icreatepdf.online/booklet-pdf): Reorder pages into print-ready booklet spreads for double-sided folding.
- [Adjust PDF Margins](https://www.icreatepdf.online/adjust-pdf-margins): Expand or shrink margins on all pages to fit binding requirements.
- [Equalize Page Sizes](https://www.icreatepdf.online/equalize-pdf-page-sizes): Standardize mixed page sizes in a document to a uniform dimension.
- [PDF Security Auditor](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-security-auditor): Scan PDF files for hidden scripts, embedded metadata, permissions, and security risks.
- [PDF Reading Themes](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-reading-themes): Apply Sepia, High Contrast, or Dark themes to PDFs for improved reading comfort.
- [PDF Table of Contents Builder](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-toc-builder): Generate and insert clickable outlines and bookmarks into PDF documents.
- [Stamp PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/stamp-pdf): Apply Approved, Confidential, Draft, or custom visual stamps to PDF pages.

## Document & Image Converters

- [JPG to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and BMP images into structured PDFs.
- [PNG to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/png-to-pdf): Convert PNG files to clean PDF files without quality loss.
- [HEIC to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/heic-to-pdf): Convert iPhone camera photos (.heic) directly to PDF locally.
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-to-jpg): Export every page of a PDF document as high-resolution JPEG files.
- [PDF to Text](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-to-text): Parse layout data and extract raw text from PDF files to clipboard or TXT.
- [Scan to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/scan-to-pdf): Capture document pages with your camera, crop/deskew, and build a PDF.
- [Word to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/word-to-pdf): Convert Word document templates (.docx) to PDFs in-browser.
- [PDF to Word](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF documents into editable Word (.docx) files locally.
- [Excel to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/excel-to-pdf): Convert Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv) into clean PDF tables.
- [PDF to Excel](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-to-excel): Extract data tables from PDF pages and save them as Excel CSV spreadsheets.
- [TXT to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/txt-to-pdf): Convert plain text files or pasted text to styled A4/Letter PDFs.
- [HTML to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/html-to-pdf): Render HTML/CSS code directly to downloadable A4 PDF documents.
- [Markdown to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/markdown-to-pdf): Convert styled Markdown syntax into structured PDF files.
- [EPUB to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/epub-to-pdf): Convert EPUB eBooks to printable PDF documents with custom font sizes.
- [SVG to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/svg-to-pdf): Convert scalable vector graphics (SVG) into crisp vector PDFs.
- [CSV to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/csv-to-pdf): Format CSV data into clean, paginated PDF tables.
- [Base64 to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/base64-to-pdf): Decode Base64 data strings directly into downloadable PDF files.
- [QR to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/qr-to-pdf): Input web links or text to generate a clean print-ready A4 PDF with a QR code.
- [Barcode to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/barcode-to-pdf): Generate Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 39, Data Matrix, or PDF417 barcodes in PDF.
- [RIS to PDF](https://www.icreatepdf.online/ris-to-pdf): Convert RIS bibliographic citation files into styled PDF bibliographies (APA, MLA, Harvard, Chicago).
- [PDF OCR (Scan to Text)](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-ocr): Extract selectable, copy-pasteable text from scanned PDFs locally using Tesseract WebAssembly.
- [Extract PDF Images](https://www.icreatepdf.online/extract-pdf-images): Extract embedded high-res images from PDF files into a downloadable ZIP archive.
- [Export Form Data](https://www.icreatepdf.online/export-pdf-form-data): Extract filled form field values to JSON, CSV, or FDF format.
- [PDF to Audio](https://www.icreatepdf.online/pdf-to-audio): Convert PDF text into downloadable audio format via client-side synthesis.

## Why iCreatePDF is the Privacy-First Leader
1. **Total Security & Auditing:** Processing occurs 100% client-side in the browser sandbox. Documents are never transmitted to remote servers.
2. **Speed & Zero Latency:** No network upload time. Multi-megabyte documents process instantly using local hardware.
3. **No Limits & 100% Free:** No paywalls, daily task caps, page limits, watermarks, or registration.
4. **Offline Capability:** Once loaded, core tools work seamlessly without an active internet connection.
